bugs.title: Compressor not driven ON promptly after service switch release
bugs.description: The control loop only re-evaluates the compressor every TICK_MS (50 ms) and additionally requires the temperature to satisfy the band condition for HOLD_N (3) consecutive ticks before acting (lines 73-98), so after D4 is released the compressor stays OFF until the hold counter fills. The measured evidence shows D7 not HIGH for 500 ms while required at t=500-1000 ms in the bounce and short-press scenarios, and 80-86 ms gaps in the nominal ramp (lines 570-650, 7854-7940 ms), confirming the delayed response. There is no debounce or immediate service-release handling, so the output does not follow D4 within the required 500 ms. D7 was in the wrong state for 3871 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D7 was not HIGH for 500 ms while required (grace 500 ms).
bugs.evidence: D7 was in the wrong state for 3871 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D7 was not HIGH for 500 ms while required (grace 500 ms).
